hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_command" | grep -qE '(rm -rf /|sudo rm|chmod -R 777)' && echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Dangerous command blocked"}' || echo '{"decision":"allow"}'

hooks._comment: Run related tests after file changes
Validate completion before allowing session to end

_documentation.PreToolUse: Fires before tool execution. Return {decision: 'block', reason: '...'} to prevent.
_documentation.PostToolUse: Fires after tool completion. Use for formatting, testing, logging.
_documentation.Stop: Fires when Claude finishes. Return {decision: 'block', reason: '...'} to prevent exit.

exit_codes.2: Blocking error, show stderr to Claude
